title: spec(automation): `FlowRuntimeState` gains a structured discriminator beside `reason` (deployment policy vs a binding failure), so a consumer can classify a disabled packaged flow without parsing the sentence (objectui#12609)
body:
Filing gate ③: the classification half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12609 (filed by the epic PM from the 2026-10-16 Setup review, under the maintainer's 「全部立卡」). It was split by triage at that card's `pm:retriage` (domain:ui seat 3, `6210398091`, option B). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, as a vertical seam: the contract in `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, and its producer in `packages/services/service-automation`, declared to `domain:services`.

## Governing text

`FlowRuntimeState.reason`, verbatim: "A free-form sentence, deliberately — the shape the two surfaces that already carry this reason use. Consumers RENDER it; ⛔ do not parse it." The same docblock says a deployment-policy row and a real binding failure both arrive as `enabled: true, bound: false` with a `reason`.

## The gap

The console wants an "Off by deployment policy" chip on exactly the policy-disabled rows, and a one-time banner. It cannot tell those rows apart without parsing `reason`, which the contract forbids. objectui already obeys the rule: `PackagedFlowRow.reason` is rendered, never read (objectui#9217).

## The change

- An optional, closed discriminator beside `reason` on `FlowRuntimeState`. For example `unboundCause: 'deployment_policy' | 'binding_failure'`; the spec seat names it by the spec's conventions.
- `service-automation` stamps it wherever it composes `bound: false` today.
- `reason` stays the rendered sentence.
- `Clause-②: yes` (widening), with a contract review at tier.

## Grade

**p1 + `target:v18`.** It is a widening of a spec contract (protocol-first class).

## Downstream

The console half (the chip and the banner) is filed by this card's claimant on objectui once the field is in a published `@objectstack/spec`. objectstack-ai/objectui#12609 is narrowed meanwhile to what needs no classification.

## Dedupe

The parent is objectstack-ai/objectui#12609.
